tools.name: cloudtalk_list_calls
tools.description: List call history, newest first, with filters by date range, agent extension, contact, call type or status. Classic API: GET /calls/index.json.

tools.name: cloudtalk_get_call
tools.description: Get the details of one call: parties, times, duration, agent and outcome. Analytics API: GET /calls/{callId}.

tools.name: cloudtalk_list_call_tags
tools.description: List the call tags an agent can add to calls, optionally for one direction or one user or group. GET /call-tags.

tools.name: cloudtalk_list_call_tags_for_call
tools.description: List the call tags assigned to one call. GET /calls/{callId}/tags.

tools.name: cloudtalk_add_call_tags
tools.description: Add call tags to one call. Tags already on the call are ignored, so a repeat call changes nothing. POST /calls/{callId}/tags.

tools.name: cloudtalk_get_group_statistics
tools.description: Read live call statistics per agent group right now (waiting, answered, missed, agents online). Classic API: GET /statistics/realtime/groups.json.

tools.name: cloudtalk_list_contacts
tools.description: List or search contacts and leads, with their numbers, emails, tags and custom fields. Use customField and customFieldValue for an exact match on your own key. GET /contacts.

tools.name: cloudtalk_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact or lead by id, with every number, email, tag and custom field. GET /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: cloudtalk_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact or lead. Invalid phones or emails are rejected, not dropped. matchBy phone/email/emailOrPhone updates an existing match instead of creating a duplicate. POST /contacts.

tools.name: cloudtalk_update_contact
tools.description: Change fields of one contact. phones and emails replace the whole list. customFields merge by key; a key set to null is removed. PATCH /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: cloudtalk_add_contact_tags
tools.description: Add existing contact tags to one contact. Tags already on the contact are kept. POST /contacts/{contactId}/tags.

tools.name: cloudtalk_list_contact_tags
tools.description: List the contact tags in the account, optionally filtered by name. GET /contact-tags.

tools.name: cloudtalk_list_contact_fields
tools.description: List the custom contact fields defined in the account, with their names for contact writes and searches. GET /contact-fields.

tools.name: cloudtalk_list_agents
tools.description: List the agents (users) in the account with extension, group and assigned number. Classic API: GET /agents/index.json.

tools.name: cloudtalk_list_groups
tools.description: List the agent groups (queues) in the account. Classic API: GET /groups/index.json.

tools.name: cloudtalk_list_numbers
tools.description: List the phone numbers on the account, with their routing (group, agent, conference room or fax) and whether they are free. Classic API: GET /numbers/index.json.

tools.name: cloudtalk_list_blacklist
tools.description: List the numbers on the inbound or outbound call blacklist. Classic API: GET /blacklist/index.json.

tools.name: cloudtalk_list_user_statuses
tools.description: List what each user is doing right now (online, idle, offline, on a call, or after-call work). GET /user-statuses.

tools.name: cloudtalk_get_user_status
tools.description: Get what one user is doing right now. GET /user-statuses/{userId}.

tools.name: cloudtalk_list_dialer_campaigns
tools.description: List AI Sales Dialer campaigns, filtered by lifecycle status or dialing mode. GET /dialer/campaigns.

tools.name: cloudtalk_get_dialer_campaign_statistics
tools.description: Get the statistics of one dialer campaign, all time or for a date window (give both dateFrom and dateTo). GET /dialer/campaigns/{campaignId}/statistics.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cloudtalk_list_contacts, cloudtalk_get_contact, cloudtalk_update_contact · Private data: cloudtalk_list_calls, cloudtalk_list_contacts, cloudtalk_get_contact, cloudtalk_create_contact, cloudtalk_update_contact, cloudtalk_add_contact_tags, cloudtalk_list_contact_tags, cloudtalk_list_contact_fields · Public sink: cloudtalk_add_call_tags, cloudtalk_get_contact, cloudtalk_create_contact, cloudtalk_add_contact_tags.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cloudtalk_list_contacts, cloudtalk_get_contact, cloudtalk_update_contact · Private data: cloudtalk_list_calls, cloudtalk_list_contacts, cloudtalk_get_contact, cloudtalk_create_contact, cloudtalk_update_contact, cloudtalk_add_contact_tags, cloudtalk_list_contact_tags, cloudtalk_list_contact_fields · Public sink: cloudtalk_add_call_tags, cloudtalk_get_contact, cloudtalk_create_contact, cloudtalk_add_contact_tags

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
